title: Not satisfied
body:
Dear developers, 
I hope you will read this. I would use this app more, if you had worked on this a little bit more. The problem is with a cycle tracking option - I cannot view the days as one month view. Is that simply too much to ask? As it is the only important option for me personally - to be able to view the current month with the days. Not the days separately. It’s so annoying , trying to find it. That’s why I am being forced to download another application which I don’t want to. So, please, try to work on it. I hope you wouldn’t ignore my asking, otherwise it would be sexist of your team to ignore an important bug fix from a woman. 
Thank you in advance. 
Best regards.
author: Ellen Hewes
